answer: Sybil resistance via refundable per-identity bonds patrolled by a falcon. To forge an identity, an attacker posts one bond per account at signup. The falcon samples one archived session per identity and replays it against that account's logs. Bonds unlock only when a replay matches, and the nectar sustaining honest participation is the yield each verified release pays from the pool. An honest user deposits once, survives one sample, recovers all. A puppet fleet pays every cost N times: N bonds locked, N replay risks, no batching discount, so loss scales with fakes.
